questions.text: How often does your recorded inventory match actual physical stock counts?
How frequently do you conduct physical inventory counts, such as cycle counts or full counts?
How confident are you in the accuracy of your current inventory records?
How would you rate the organization and layout of your warehouse or storage space?
How efficiently can staff locate and retrieve items when needed?
How well is incoming inventory processed and put away in a timely manner?
Do you have documented standard operating procedures for inventory handling?
How consistently are inventory processes followed across shifts or locations?
